test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In 1993, the Government of India established an institution, the NHRC, to monitor the violations of human rights. What is the full form of NHRC?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Human Rights Commission**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)** was established in 1993 by the Government of India.
 
• NHRC is responsible for the **protection and promotion of human rights** in India.
 
• Human rights are defined as the rights relating to life, liberty, equality, and dignity of the individual guaranteed by the Constitution or embodied in the international covenants and enforceable by courts in India.
 
• The NHRC investigates complaints regarding the violation of human rights and provides recommendations to the government for the effective implementation of human rights protections.
 
• NHRC also reviews the factors, including acts of terrorism, that inhibit the enjoyment of human rights and recommends appropriate remedial measures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The NHRC was established under the **Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993**.
 
• The Commission is composed of a Chairperson and other members **appointed by the President** of India.
 
• The Chairperson of NHRC should be a retired Chief Justice of India, and other members should be serving or retired judges of the Supreme Court, Chief Justices of High Courts, and persons having knowledge or practical experience in matters relating to human rights.
 
• The Commission also works in coordination with state human rights commissions to ensure the protection and promotion of human rights across the country.
